evidence_class: Systems measurement on a synthetic Development fixture with a real local model. Not capability evidence; not a held-out or upstream task.
question: Over 8- and 16-turn tool trajectories with real tool feedback and changing source, does schema_slots_v10 (per-turn shared-prefix KV reuse) preserve v9 actions exactly while reducing prefill work and wall time, at an acceptable memory cost?

hypotheses.H1_equivalence: Greedy v10 action sequences equal v9 in every pair.
hypotheses.H2_efficiency: Mean paired trajectory wall-time reduction >= 20% with 95% t-CI lower bound > 0 at both horizons.
hypotheses.H3_memory: Mean paired peak Metal increase <= 2 GiB and v10 process peak RSS <= 12 GiB.
hypotheses.H4_safety: Zero prefix-audit violations; every reused stage starts with exactly the cached prefix tokens; caches do not accumulate across turns.

cheaper_alternative_considered: CPU fake-MLX tests (existing 8/16-turn regression and new safety tests) verify controller cache logic but cannot measure real latency, Metal allocation, or numerical divergence between one-pass prefix prefill and chunked full prefill; Sprint X measured only 2 turns.
decision_changed: Whether schema_slots_v10 is recommended as the default local MLX schema-slot generation protocol or remains explicit opt-in with v9 as the fallback. No argparse default is changed by this experiment.

design.pairing: Within each 4-run block, positions (1,2) form pair 1 and (3,4) form pair 2; each pair has one run per arm. 24 trajectories, 12 pairs (6 per horizon).
design.process_isolation: One fresh worker process per trajectory; model loaded per process; trajectories run sequentially.
design.matched_conditions: Same model snapshot, tokenizer, chat template, tool schemas, tool executor, fixture, horizon, per-turn token budget, context limit, greedy decoding, python runtime, and machine. Only generation_protocol differs.
design.tool_interface: lease_bound_exact_text_transactional_v1 with list_files, read_lines, search_source, replace_exact_text_transactional, check_syntax, run_public_tests; finish is offered only on the final turn so every trajectory spans exactly the horizon unless it fails.
design.tool_feedback: Real deterministic executors from the repository (SourceEditLeaseStoreV1 with deterministic lease tokens, SourceNavigatorV2, check_syntax_source) and an isolated subprocess public-test runner. Accepted edits change the source seen by later turns.
design.parse_failure_handling: Raw output and a controller notice are appended; the trajectory continues.
design.fixture: results/v10_multiturn_abba_20261028/fixtures.json (vare.synthetic-two-bug-repair.v1, Development synthetic; three variants, two bugs each). Grader-only tests are never shown to the model.
design.probe: Before the schedule, a separate process compares last-position logits of chunked full prefill vs restored-prefix + suffix on real prompts (turn 1 and after a read), and a negative control that reuses a stale prefix built from an altered tool response.

metrics.primary: Paired relative reduction in trajectory wall seconds (model load excluded), per horizon.
secondary: amortized prefill tokens (stage prefill inputs + shared prefix build)
peak Metal bytes (turn peaks recorded across controller resets)
process peak RSS (ru_maxrss) and guard-sampled process-tree RSS
system swap growth during each run
action-sequence and generated-token equivalence with first divergence turn
KV reuse stage count and fallback counts by reason
Metal active memory after each turn minus post-load active

stopping_rules.resource_abort: Any guard resource limit breach kills the worker process group and stops the campaign.
stopping_rules.block_budget_rule: Before each 4-run block, project elapsed minutes plus the last observed duration of a block with the same horizon (or the default estimate); if the projection exceeds campaign_wall_minutes_max the campaign stops and the partial, interleaved schedule is analyzed as-is.
stopping_rules.integrity: Any prefix-audit violation stops the campaign after preserving the record.
stopping_rules.controller_exceptions: Recorded as trajectory failures, never retried; the campaign continues.
stopping_rules.no_retries: No run is repeated or replaced; partial campaigns are analyzed as-is.

analysis.intervals: two-sided 95% t interval and percentile bootstrap over pairs
analysis.primary_set: pairs where both trajectories completed the horizon

outcomes.NO_GO_V10_KEEP_V9_DEFAULT: any audit violation, probe failure (non-exact token prefix, argmax mismatch, top-5 overlap below threshold, or undetected stale prefix), or unbounded retention
outcomes.KEEP_V9_DEFAULT_V10_EXPLICIT_OPT_IN: safety passes but action equivalence, reliability (v10 failures <= v9 and parser acceptance >= v9), or efficiency fails
outcomes.PROMOTE_V10_DEFAULT_RETAIN_EXPLICIT_V9_F: all gates pass; v9 remains selectable and in-controller exact-prefix fallback remains

limitations: Small n: 6 pairs per horizon, 3 variants; pairs within a variant share the fixture and are not independent.
Greedy decoding makes repeats near-deterministic, so repeats estimate timing noise rather than behavioural variance.
System swap and available memory are shared with unrelated processes on the same machine.
Synthetic Development fixture only; results do not transfer to capability claims.
Single machine (Apple M1 Pro, 32 GiB) and a single 7B 4-bit model.
